verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a native Vanta AI Agent with agentic search and question-asking across policies, controls, frameworks, tests and documents. It also ships an official MCP server that lets assistants like Claude, Cursor and Perplexity query controls, remediate failing tests and act on compliance data on the user's behalf, including a documented flow to list failing tests and ask for a remediation plan. However, the documented natural-language operations are limited to search, Q&A, drafting and test remediation, and broader action-taking mostly runs through third-party AI clients. Missing for 10: documentation that natural-language commands cover the product's full range of operations natively (beyond search/Q&A, drafting and test remediation), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
